notes.title: Update #6 - v1.873
notes.content:
This update includes the following changes:

 all teammate AIs are visible on the map and on the radar map as well
 performance improvements by pooling bullets and impact effects
 mouse scrolling on the side of the screen fixed as it was not working properly for some users playing in full screen
 fixed vehicle muzzle effect for the Artillery Tank, which remained visible sometimes
 achievement bug fixed: disabled AIs unlocked achievements
 fixed path finding for some maps where units were able to climb up hills


Thanks a lot for the feedback!

notes.title: Update #4 - v1.839
notes.content:
As promised this update includes the following changes:

an additional harder AI for skirmish
new rocket soldier type with target following rockets
option to quickly restart a finished game
a defense building can be constructed in parallel with another building
pressing unit group hotkeys twice will jump the camera to the next unit in the group
double clicking on a unit will select all units with the same type in the sight of the camera
shift/alt + drag selection won't reset previous unit selections
Japanese comic localization fixes

As promised this update includes the following changes:

attacked enemy units will respond to the attack even if their attacker is not in range
shooting over cliffs issue fixed
locked buildings in campaign mode won't be listed to avoid confusion
speeding up the larger units
lowering soldier training price
selected single units will show their image and a short info when hovering over the image
enemy buildings and units will be selectable to see their image and name
keeping mouse pointer in game window for users with multiple monitors

notes.title: Reconquest release date: December 16, 2016
notes.content:
Reconquest is a real-time strategy game with the classic mechanics of the 90's RTS games like Dune 2 or the Command & Conquer series.

The game takes place after World War III, when mankind got close to extinction. The player has to reconquer Earth by making better strategic decisions than their opponents. The most valuable resource that still exists, and its possession will determine outcome of battles is the radioactive shale gas.

The game can be played in 3 game modes:
- In campaign mode you can choose from the two sides: the urban forces and the outlaw clan. Both sides has 10 individual story missions where comics connects the story line between the missions.
- In skirmish mode you can compete with 3 AIs at maximum on 8 different maps.
- In trapped mode you can choose between 8 preset challenges.

The game's planned release date is December 16, 2016 on Steam for PC and Mac.
